nodes.label: ShieldPass Project
nodes.rationale: Anonymous whistleblower protocol built on RISC Zero ZK proofs, ENS identity, and Sepolia. Workers prove membership in company badge tree without revealing identity.

nodes.label: ShieldPass Architecture
nodes.rationale: Monorepo with packages: contracts (Solidity), backend (Fastify), frontend (React/Vite), zk (RISC Zero). Contracts: CompanyRegistry, BadgeTreeManager, ReportRegistry, ShieldPassResolver.

nodes.label: Deployed Contracts
nodes.rationale: Sepolia addresses: CompanyRegistry (0xba47...555f8), BadgeTreeManager (0xD23B...6294), ReportRegistry (0x4935...CB5F1), ShieldPassResolver (0x112F...4616c), RISC0 Verifier (0x925d...9187), Boundless Market (0xc21...ba7d).

nodes.label: ZK Circuit Design
nodes.rationale: RISC Zero guest with circom-compatible BN254 Poseidon. Leaf: Poseidon([0, badge]), Inner node: Poseidon([1, left, right]), Nullifier: Poseidon([2, badge, periodId]). Proves badge membership in Merkle tree.
